topic: TestFlaggingAHugeHitIsBounded is a timing test that fails under load
detail: internal/memctx TestFlaggingAHugeHitIsBounded failed once in a local go test ./... run while a Swift build ran alongside ('Flagged on an 8 MiB "a " hit took 289.841417ms'), then passed when its package ran alone; CI passed. Its wall-clock bound makes it a candidate for the recurring flaky tests SP-082 fixed: bound the work it measures (e.g. a count of steps) rather than elapsed time, or widen the bound.
